safetyInvariants: Audio-control packets allow only LIKELY_BARRIER or UNCERTAIN.
Controls are explicit SCOPED_AUDIO_CONTROL packets, not NO_REVIEW and not LIKELY_OK.
Negative/control rows do not convert to final judgments.

findings.finding: Custom pause/mute/volume controls were previously treated as valid by label or aria-controls alone.
findings.remediation: probeAudioAutoplay now exercises plausible custom controls and requires an observed pause, mute, or volume-reduction effect before treating them as independent controls.

findings.finding: Generated-fixture evidence and live browser policy could diverge on autoplay behavior.
findings.remediation: orchestrator and saved-pressure browser launches now include --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required, matching the fixture validator and capture lanes.

findings.finding: Live saved-page audibility remains fixture-marker dependent.
findings.remediation: Disclosed as a remaining limitation; arbitrary saved pages without generated non-silent evidence stay UNCERTAIN rather than becoming definite barriers.
